content.short: Laminar is a Hyperliquid-native DEX pairing concentrated liquidity with intent-based routing.
content.description: Laminar trades on Hyperliquid using concentrated liquidity pools alongside intent-based order routing, so a trade can be filled from pooled liquidity or by a solver, whichever serves it better. Mixing the two models is a practical response to a chain where a deep native order book sits next to a young pool-based DeFi layer.
content.meta: Concentrated liquidity and solver-based routing side by side on Hyperliquid.
